name: scribe
description: Functional-document authoring: ADR, PRD, SPEC, LLD, PLAN, ROADMAP, TICKET, TASK — standards, forge, review, validator, eight type templates, and bug-report (capture -> classify -> record -> dispatch -> write-back for bug reports). Also covers research/measurement (research-methods, rubric-author), markdown↔markup conversion (markdown-to-markup, html-to-markdown), knowledge/reference authoring (reference-author, knowledge-author, llms-txt-author, vision-memo-author), and a fresh-context doc-reviewer agent alongside the researcher agent.
